query:
SELECT 
  c.name AS 客戶,
  COUNT(*) AS 需求單數,
  MIN(DATE(d.date)) AS 最早日期,
  MAX(DATE(d.date)) AS 最晚日期
FROM demands d
JOIN clients c ON d.clientId = c.id
WHERE d.status = 'pending'
  AND MONTH(d.date) = 5 AND YEAR(d.date) = 2026
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY c.name;
